name: Love's Gift
summary: Love's Gift is the penultimate quest in the Horde warlock chain to summon and bind a succubus. After being tracked down and revived in the Barrens, the dying Grunt Dogran relinquishes a treasured keepsake to provide the bait necessary for the dark ritual.

sections.title: A Grunt's Sacrifice
sections.body: Found imprisoned and tortured by the Bristleback quilboar in the Barrens, Grunt Dogran is nursed back to consciousness by Ken'zigla's draught. Knowing his body is broken beyond recovery, Dogran resolves to face death in glorious battle rather than return to his mate, Zankaja, as an invalid. He surrenders a dirt-caked pendant—a gift born of pure love—asking only that she never learn of what he gave up.

sections.title: Bait for a Demon
sections.body: To summon and subjugate a succubus, a warlock requires a talisman of intense, unblemished emotion. Succubi feed on mortal desire and pervert genuine affection into anguish. Dogran's pendant carries the weight of authentic devotion and tragic parting. Returned to Gan'rul Bloodeye in the shadowy clefts of Orgrimmar, the talisman is cleaned and polished so its radiant emotional resonance can lure the devourer of souls across the Twisting Nether.

faq.q: Why does a warlock need Dogran's pendant?
faq.answer: Succubi are demonic beings drawn to deep mortal passions, which they twist and consume. Dogran's pendant represents selfless love and heartfelt sacrifice, making it the perfect mystical lure to entice a succubus into the summoner's circle.

Dogran is a Horde warrior captured and brutally tortured by the Bristleback quilboar in the southern Barrens. Though rescued and revived with an alchemical tonic, his grievous injuries leave him unable to live as a proud warrior.

Zankaja is Dogran's young mate who waited anxiously for news of his whereabouts. To spare her the sorrow and burden of nursing a broken shell, Dogran chooses to give up her token and seek a warrior's death.

faq.q: Why does Dogran ask you to keep this secret from Zankaja?
faq.answer: Dogran refuses to chain a young mate to a dying invalid. He surrenders her pendant knowing it will never return to her, but begs that she be spared the guilt of knowing how his fate ended.

faq.q: Who cleans the pendant and why?
faq.answer: Gan'rul Bloodeye, the warlock trainer in Orgrimmar, takes the pendant. He cleans off the filth and grime so its bright, pristine appearance and emotional resonance will prove irresistible to the summoned demon.

faq.q: What happens immediately after completing this quest?
faq.answer: Gan'rul Bloodeye directs you to bring the purified pendant into the summoning circle beneath Orgrimmar to cast the binding ritual and defeat the succubus in single combat.

angles.text: The binding of a succubus teaches warlocks that demons are not merely summoned with arcane power, but ensnared by exploiting their hunger for raw mortal passions like love and grief.
Grunt Dogran embodies the harsh martial ethos of the Horde, preferring to die on the battlefield rather than live as a crippled burden to his kin.
